result:
I’d make empathy a structural requirement of power. Governments, corporations, and institutions would have to measure decisions by whom they harm, whom they help, and whether they preserve people’s dignity—then face consequences when they don’t.

Not kindness as sentiment, but as a rule embedded in the systems that shape people’s lives. Most of the world’s cruelty doesn’t come from monsters; it comes from ordinary people following incentives that reward harm. I’d change the incentives.
